title: Find Corporate Domains
description:
A customer list stores email addresses. Your SaaS integrates only with customers whose email ends in a **known corporate domain**: `acme.com`, `globex.com`, or `initech.com`.

Find every customer whose email ends with exactly one of those domains. Use a single `REGEXP_LIKE(email, ...)`. Name the columns `id`, `name`, and `email`. Return rows in any order.
hint: The `$` must be anchored at the end, and `|` alternation provides the choices: `@(acme|globex|initech)\.com$`. Escape the dot before 'com' as `\.` so it is a literal dot.
outputExplanation: bob@acme.com, carol@globex.com and eve@initech.com all match. alice@acme.org is a different TLD, dave@fakeacme.com only *contains* the text acme but doesn't end with @acme.com, and a@acme.com.mx has extra text after the domain.
